title: Electric Field & Potential
description: Visualizes the electric field of a dipole (positive charge at (−2,0) and negative charge at (2,0)). Field vectors are computed using Coulomb's inverse-square law with a softening factor of 0.1 to avoid singularities. An ArrowVectorField renders the combined E-field across a grid from x ∈ [−6, 6] and y ∈ [−4, 4].

softening.description: Softening factor added to distance³ to avoid division by zero

what_to_modify: Move charge positions, add a third charge, change the grid density, add equipotential contour lines, color-code arrows by field strength, or animate a test charge moving along field lines.
